subject: Follow-up: pricing & context-length profiling for Acme Robotics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:07:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: pricing & context-length profiling for Acme Robotics

Hi Alicia, thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on during the call so we can size pricing and recommend a deployment: 

Call recap:
- Primary use: customer support summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for warranty docs. Mix of short chat Q&A and long-document summarization.
- Pilot goals: 5k-10k monthly active users, ~250k-1M requests/month initially.

Immediate asks / info we need from your side to put together a pricing estimate: 
1) Typical token profile per request: avg prompt tokens and avg completion tokens (sample or logs are ideal).
2) Distribution of context-length needs: percent of requests that need 8k vs 32k vs 128k context.
3) Monthly token volume target or budget range ($/month) and any target unit economics (e.g., desired $/1M tokens).

What we covered on our side:
- Rough unit economics: for vanilla hosted sizing we'll show cost estimates across 8k/32k/128k variants and a weighted blended $/1M tokens number. We also proposed Dedicated (reserved capacity) pricing if you need consistent throughput and lower unit price.
- Performance levers: batching, KV/prefix caching (good for repeated prompts), and quantization/streaming trade-offs we'll highlight in the estimate.

Attachments: I attached a preliminary pricing worksheet and a small template CSV for you to paste sample token metrics (acme-context-profile-sample.csv).

Next steps:
- Alicia to share sample metrics or a small export with prompt/completion token counts and a rough monthly volume / target budget by 2/20.
- We'll return a formal estimate + recommended config (hosted vs dedicated and context sizing) by EOD 2/20.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment stub: acme-context-profile-sample.csv (CSV with columns: request_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,context_bytes)

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & context-length profiling for Acme Robotics

Marissa, thanks for the summary and for the template. I pasted a 48-hour sample of logs (attached) and included the high-level answers below: 

Token/profile highlights (sample of 48h):
- avg prompt tokens: 180
- avg completion tokens: 420
- median completion tokens: 350 (long tails for doc summarization)
- monthly extrapolated volume (pilot): ~250M tokens/month (prompt + completion combined)

Context-length distribution (from our sample):
- ~80% of requests use up to 8k context (short Q&A + support snippets)
- ~15% require 32k (longer warranty/manual sections)
- ~5% spike to 128k (full-article ingestion + multi-doc summarization)

Budget / unit economics:
- Procurement provided a target budget range for the pilot of $12k-$18k/month. That implies a target blended unit cost of roughly $48-$72 per 1M tokens if we aim to keep within the $/month budget assuming 250M tokens.
- That target is aggressive compared to some hosted list pricing; open to Dedicated/reserved options if you can provide a path to lower unit $/1M.

Other notes:
- We absolutely need audit logs and data retention options for the pilot (SOC2 evidence was discussed on the call).
- Can you also include a couple of scenario worksheets: (A) Hosted with burst to 32/128k, (B) Dedicated baseline 8k with enable-on-demand 128k capacity?

Files attached: 48h-sample-token-logs.csv

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Torres
Product Ops, Acme Robotics
alicia.torres@acme.com

--
Attachment stub: 48h-sample-token-logs.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-19T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & context-length profiling for Acme Robotics

Alicia, appreciate the quick turnaround and the sample logs, this is exactly what we need. A few notes from an infra/SE perspective: 

Unit economics and quick anatomy of options:
- Baseline hosted (8k): lower infra complexity. If 80% of requests are <=8k, we can optimize caching + batching to reduce effective token cost. For your sample, a hosted blended $/1M tokens will be dominated by the 32k/128k tail if those are priced significantly higher.
- Dedicated/reserved: with a committed monthly spend we can materially reduce the per-token cost for steady-state 8k workloads and provide predictable latency. We'll show committed vs on-demand 32/128k uplifts.

Pricing inputs we'll use for the worksheet (placeholders for now - will replace with final numbers in the estimate):
- 8k profile unit price (hosted): $60 per 1M tokens
- 32k uplift multiplier: +2.5x
- 128k uplift multiplier: +6x
- Dedicated baseline discount: ~35% on 8k unit price at certain commit levels

Using your 250M token pilot number and your stated budget ($12k-$18k/mo):
- At $60/1M blended we'd expect ~ $15k for 250M tokens - appears near the top of your range. If we can move to Dedicated (or you can accept higher commit), we can reach your lower bound.

Profiling asks (to refine estimate):
- Can you share percent of tokens attributable to prompt vs completion across the 32k/128k requests specifically? (Long-doc summarization tends to spike completion tokens and drives the uplift).
- Any SLA requirements for the tail (128k) or can that be best-effort / queued with higher latency?

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa & I to put together two worksheets (hosted scenario + dedicated scenario) and send by EOD 2/20.
2) If Acme likes the math, schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive next week to decide config and commit levels.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Immediate asks from us to finalize the estimate:
- A small sample (5-10) of long-doc requests where the completion tokens are >1k so Vivek can validate the 128k uplift math. You can paste inline or attach.
- Procurement: will you confirm whether the pilot needs invoice terms (Net30) or a credit card procurement path? That drives how we price reserved capacity.
